name: Permit of Stay (Foreign Investor)

requirements.blocker_text: Must hold a Ministry of Commerce business permit and submit a business profile describing operations.
requirements.fix_path: Register the business and obtain a Ministry of Commerce business permit.

outcome.duration_length: not specified in sources located in this build

sources.title: Federal Republic of Somalia, official government services portal -- Permit of Stay for foreign investors: requires a written application with detailed personal information, Ministry of Commerce business permit, valid passport (12+ months), business profile, professional qualifications documentation, professional CV; processed in-person at regional centers; fee US$5

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Somalia). Published on tier-1 sourcing, same government service page as so_work_permit.json but the investor-specific track. GENUINE GAP, NOT FABRICATED: no minimum investment amount, sector restriction, or capital threshold is stated anywhere in the source -- this route is gated on holding a registered, permitted business, not on a numeric capital figure, which is unusual in this dataset (most business/investor routes elsewhere specify a dollar threshold). Somalia's 1987 Foreign Investment Law may specify capital or sector terms but its current legal force and text were not independently verified in this build (UNCTAD's Investment Policy Hub lists a Somalia Foreign Investment Law entry, but it predates the state collapse of 1991 and the current Federal Government's re-establishment, and its present-day applicability is a genuinely open question this build does not resolve) -- flagged for follow-up rather than modeled as a requirement. POLITICAL CONTEXT: see so_visitor_visa.json notes.
